title: Woman at Waterfront Boardwalk, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A 1950s vintage black-and-white snapshot featuring a woman posing by a metal guardrail along a windy coast or beach front. She wears classic mid-century casual attire featuring capri pants and a sleeveless button-front top. The photo has scalloped/deckled edges and album binder holes along the top edge.
